name: singapore-compliance-2026
display_name: Singapore Compliance 2026 — MAS Notice 626 (as amended 2025), FSMA DTSP, PSA, PDPA
description: Structured knowledge graph for Singapore financial-sector compliance: MAS Notice 626 for banks, issued under section 16 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 and amended with effect from 1 July 2025 (money laundering includes proliferation financing; beneficial ownership of legal arrangements; STR copy to MAS on request), with the parallel AML/CFT Notices 824, SFA04-N02, 314, PSN01/PSN02, VCC-N01 and FSM-N27; FSMA 2022 and its Part 9 digital token service provider regime (in force 30 June 2025, no transitional arrangement); the Payment Services Act 2019 and its DPT user-protection measures (2024-2025); the Banking, Insurance, Securities and Futures and Financial Advisers Acts; the PDPA (breach notification, penalties) and the PDPC Model AI Governance Framework; MAS TRM, BCM and outsourcing guidance; the Variable Capital Companies Act 2018; SGX/ACRA climate reporting; the Workplace Fairness Act 2025 (not yet in force); the CDSA, PCA and TSOFA; and the authorities MAS, STRO, PDPC, ACRA, CPIB, CCCS, IRAS and MOM. Version 1.0.1 (2026-10-02): every entity and relationship was checked by an AI model (Claude Opus 5.5) against official sources — Singapore Statutes Online, mas.gov.sg, pdpc.gov.sg, acra.gov.sg, police.gov.sg, mom.gov.sg, cpib.gov.sg, ccs.gov.sg, iras.gov.sg, the SGX RuleBook and fatf-gafi.org. Wrong statements were corrected and unsupported ones removed; each entity's metadata.source lists the texts relied on and metadata.source_quote, where present, is a verbatim extract. This is not human validation: validated_by is unset and content_confirmed is false until a qualified Singapore practitioner has reviewed the pack.
